subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MANTLE' is written as 'JZKGIV' and 'TINKER' is written as 'QRKPBI'. How will 'DERIVE' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9b750f6c904cab86cf5cfdc4bfd5c933fca17392b1cf29a1d418dffc6cc08ac.png] 

1) 'MANTLE' is written as 'JZKGIV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9f894501192c48e3fc71f0dfd2dc427aaf7d39f0e261307d67643b430de759d.png] 

And, 

2) ' TINKER' is written as 'QRKPBI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5aa78a760f6287eb536bd2f9d642592f097346e835a0198a51ad2d928f52e6d.png] 

Similarley,

3) 'DERIVE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f8bb46afd171443201086bc0a2cd4bdaa44000c35f03284c2420995f2ea1842.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is 'AVORSV'.
